page.overview:
Who is Mott?

is the main protagonist of Sea Bonnies, the second story of Fazbear Frights 10: Friendly Face.

Mott has his father’s plain brown hair. With naturally wavy hair, hooded dark brown eyes, a strong chin, and great teeth, Mott is considered "objectively good-looking." After his 13th birthday he gets taller and begins to work out, getting broad shoulders.
